name: hcapp_processBulkPayment
description: Records payments for multiple hashers at a single event in one operation. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 41, @param NULL — device-secret token). Permission gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission @functionKey = 'bulkPayment' in the event's kennel, with @isHareOfEvent = 1 when the caller hares this run (errorCode 1341, errorType 13 otherwise; see /hc-authorizations). Accepts a COMMA-separated list of hasher UUIDs, upserts HasherEventMap attendance (AttendenceState = 20, RsvpState = 3), sets Event.DoTrackHashCash, cancels EVERY uncancelled payment those hashers hold at the event (any ProductType), auto-creates follower HasherKennelMap rows for hash-credit payers who have none, and inserts one Payment per hasher with set-based per-hasher RUN pricing (member vs non-member rate, HKM discount amount then percent). After commit it refreshes kennel credit per hasher (CURSOR over HC6.nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser), run counts for everyone changed in the last second (HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers), then delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData whose rowsets follow the SP's own. Supported paymentTypes: 2=free, 3=cash, 4=bank transfer, 5=cash other, 6=hash credit, 7=bank transfer other, 8=credit other; any other value (1, 100) skips the INSERT silently. Since 2026-10-13 the cancel-existing step only cancels uncancelled payments of the same @productType on the event, as hcapp_processPayment does.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated against the device secret by HC6.ValidateAppAuth. No SQL default.

parameters.name: userIdsWhoPaid
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hasher UUIDs (UNIQUEIDENTIFIER strings). Parsed via STRING_SPLIT(@userIdsWhoPaid, ',') + TRY_CAST; invalid entries are silently skipped. Default NULL, which returns errorCode 1241, errorType 12. Note the delimiter is ',' not the project's '|' (see codeSmells).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The event to record payments against. Required — NULL or empty GUID triggers a param validation error (errorCode=1241, errorType=12). No SQL default.

parameters.name: paymentType
parameters.description: Payment method code. Values 2–8 trigger payment INSERT; values outside this range skip the INSERT silently. 2=free, 3=cash, 4=bank transfer, 5=cash other, 6=hash credit, 7=bank transfer other, 8=credit other. No SQL default.

parameters.name: productType
parameters.description: Written to Payment.ProductType (default 1=event; 2=membership; 3=haberdashery; NULL coerced to 1) — but the SP always prices as a RUN payment and marks attendance 20, so 2 and 3 produce a run-priced, attendance-marking row labelled as another product (see codeSmells).

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to hcapp_syncEventAdminData. Default 'ignore' (meaning return all rows).

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to hcapp_syncEventAdminData. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: paymentsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to hcapp_syncEventAdminData. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: transactionTimestamp
parameters.description: Optional PaidDate override as an ISO datetime string. Parsed via TRY_CAST(LEFT(@transactionTimestamp, 23) AS DATETIME) — a malformed string silently becomes GETDATE() rather than an error; NULL also falls back to GETDATE().
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) parsed as DATETIME (no offset) and inserted into Payment.PaidDate DATETIMEOFFSET(7) — the implicit widening assumes +00:00, so a client-local timestamp is stored as if it were UTC.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Write SP success envelope. Always returned as the first rowset. On success: success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL. On any failure (auth, param, or unhandled DB error): success=0 with errorCode and errorType set.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1241 for param/auth validation errors; 1941 for unhandled DB errors.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 12 for param validation; errorType from ValidateAppAuth on auth failure; 19 for unhandled DB errors.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 only on error. Contains structured error detail for display and logging.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry created for this error.

rowsets.name: AdHocBulkResult
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on success only. Single row summarising the HEM upsert counts.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: Human-readable summary: 'N records updated, M records inserted' where N=HEM rows updated and M=HEM rows inserted.

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ are the delegated output of HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — the full event admin sync payload. See that SP's contract for column definitions. Only returned on success.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState=20, RsvpState=3, updatedAt for parsed hashers that already have a HEM row for the event (lines 175-186); rows are first taken under UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK (161-170).
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap for parsed hashers without a HEM row (AttendenceState=20, RsvpState=3, IsHare=0, VirginVisitorType=0) (190-203).
UPDATE HC.Event SET DoTrackHashCash=1 if not already set (210-211).
UPDATE HC.Payment SET IsCancelled=1, CancelledDate, CancelledBy_UserId, updatedAt for ALL uncancelled payments of the parsed hashers at the event, every ProductType (216-228).
INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap (Following=1, IsKennelFollowing=1, IsMember=0) for paymentType 6 payers who exist in HC.Hasher and have no live HKM row at the kennel (238-256).
INSERT HC.Payment — one row per parsed hasher with a HEM row, run pricing, PaymentReference 'HC:' + NEWID() without dashes, PaymentProvider '' (258-311); only for paymentType 2-8.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on validation (1241), permission (1341, after ROLLBACK) and unhandled (1941) errors.

Post-commit, outside TRY: EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser once per parsed hasher via CURSOR (341-352); EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers @updatedSince = one second before the transaction began (355).
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData with the three forwarded watermarks, @procName = this SP and @param = the device secret (equivalent to NULL in ValidateAppAuth) (371-383).

codeSmells.issue: @productType accepted but priced and attendance-marked as a run payment
codeSmells.detail: @productType reaches only the INSERT's ProductType column (line 305). Pricing (263-285) is always the run fee with run discounts, attendance is always set to 20 (181, 200) and DoTrackHashCash is set — so a bulk membership (2) or haberdashery (3) call writes a row labelled as that product carrying the run price, marks the hasher as at the hash, and never advances MembershipExpirationDate. Either refuse productType <> 1 with the error envelope or implement the per-product pricing the single-payment SP has.

These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken, @paymentType. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

Line 164 (and the five copies): STRING_SPLIT(@userIdsWhoPaid, ','). The project rule is '|' for every delimited-list parameter. GUIDs cannot contain a comma so this one is safe today, but it is the pattern the next copy will inherit. Changing it means changing the app's join('|') in the same release.

Lines 331-362: the credit cursor, nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers, the envelope and the adHocData SELECT all run after END CATCH. A failure there is a raw 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row AFTER the payments have committed — the phone sees an error for money that was recorded and may re-submit, which this SP (unlike processPayment) has no idempotency key to absorb: the re-submit cancels and re-inserts every payment.

codeSmells.issue: @kennelId unguarded if the event does not exist
codeSmells.detail: Line 126 selects @kennelId from HC.Event with no existence check. For an unknown @eventId the permission check runs with @kennelId NULL (denied, so in practice this path ends at 1341 'Not authorised' — a misleading message for 'no such run').

codeSmells.issue: Silent no-op when paymentType is outside 2-8
codeSmells.detail: Lines 233-312: for @paymentType 1, 100 or anything else the INSERT block is skipped with no error, but attendance has already been marked and every existing payment cancelled (221-228). The caller gets success=1 and 'N records updated'. Refuse unsupported types before the transaction.

Lines 268-275: '(... - DiscountAmount) * (1.0 - DiscountPercent / 100.0)' — the 1.0 and 100.0 literals are DECIMAL, but DiscountPercent SMALLINT / 100.0 then multiplied yields a DECIMAL with scale growth, and the result is implicitly narrowed into SMALLMONEY on INSERT. Rounding differs from the single-payment SP, which subtracts the percentage in two SET steps on MONEY. Use DECIMAL(10,4) throughout, and the same formula in both SPs.

codeSmells.issue: Post-commit credit update still uses a CURSOR
codeSmells.detail: Lines 341-352 call nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser once per hasher through a cursor. The payment INSERT was made set-based in HC6; the credit refresh was not. Slow for a large circle, but correct.

codeSmells.issue: STRING_SPLIT of @userIdsWhoPaid is copied six times
codeSmells.detail: The ParsedGuids CTE appears at lines 162, 175, 190, 216, 258 and 332 (plus an inline variant at 247-252). One #parsed temp table filled once would remove the copies and the chance of them diverging.

breakingChanges: @userIdsWhoPaid widened from VARCHAR(8000) to NVARCHAR(MAX) — callers sending >8000 ASCII characters previously silently truncated; now accepted in full
CURSOR-based per-row payment INSERT replaced with set-based INSERT — execution order of per-hasher payment rows is no longer deterministic
TRY/CATCH and transaction added around the main body — partial writes that were previously committed in HC5 on mid-operation failure are now rolled back
DATALENGTH replaced with LEN for string length checks (no observable behavioural change for NVARCHAR inputs)
Success envelope rowset (success/errorCode/errorType) added as rowset 0 — HC5 had no such envelope; callers must read rowset index 0 before rowset 1
Delegation target updated from HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — sync rowset column shapes may differ

1.1.0 (2026-10-13): contract corrections only — permission gate, HKM follower insert and HC6.nonApi_ targets documented; TRY_CAST fallback and non-product-scoped cancel recorded; retired the '<unknown> HcVersion' smell (HC6.DeviceHcVersion is used); envelope success typed INT.
